title: EBS 라디오 입이 트이는 영어 - 6.4 Who is the Wealthiest?
vocab:
stand by me: 의리를 지키다, 내곁에 서다
immature: 미숙한, 철이 덜 든
wealthy: 부유한, 재산이 많은
pass on: 물려주다
by choice or by circumstance: 선택에 의한건지 환경에 의한건지
sentences:
We are all still legally single.
My friends said they would stand by me.
Maybe we're still be a bit immature.
I'm not sure if it was by choice or by circumstance.
